artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: THE STATE RULE. The partition is taken as a SUBTRACTION from the printed nine-state enum and never as a forward list: WIRE_STATE_DENOMINATOR is a Readonly<Record<StatusEnvelopeWire['state'], null>>, so it is exhaustive BY TYPE -- a state added to the producer's enum fails the typecheck rather than landing silently in one bucket -- and NO_ANSWER_WIRE_STATES is STATUS_WIRE_STATES.filter(not in ANSWER_BEARING_WIRE_STATES). Same shape on the view plane against ENVELOPE_STATES. formatSourceAgeForState is ADDITIVE and formatSourceAge is BYTE-UNCHANGED, deliberately: two of its three callers (tabs/analysis/StageDisplay.tsx, tabs/analysis/VariantSelector.tsx) are outside this order's <paths>, so changing it underneath them would regress files this cell may not touch (row W1-S46). NO DERIVATION: no branch reads a clock unless the wire supplied a timestamp to compare against, none falls back to a fetch time, none defaults to today.

THE CONSUMER. Calls formatSourceAgeForState(envelope.state, envelope.sourceAsOf) and carries data-slot="source-age" plus data-source-age-kind (age | no-source-age-yet | unknown), so WHICH of the three renderings landed is readable from the DOM instead of inferred from the words. The slot keeps the neutral text-slate-500 class on every no-answer state -- no error styling, no missing-data slot, no retry affordance of its own. This is 1 of the 3 formatSourceAge consumers in portal/src; the other 2 are outside the grant and are UNCHANGED (row W1-S46 carries the denominator).

EIGHT ARMS, and the ones that matter are the ones that could have failed. BOTH HALVES of the subtraction are graded (AC2 and AC3), which is what stops 'No source age yet' quietly becoming the answer for everything. The error scan carries a POSITIVE CONTROL (7 hits on an error-dressed node) so it cannot pass as a constant, and a NEGATIVE control printing the actual slot markup. A BRIDGE arm measures that the image of the four wire no-answer states stays inside the view's own no-answer set. An ANOMALY arm asserts an answer-bearing state that LOST its date still reads 'Source time unknown' and NOT the state wording. A DISCLOSURE arm asserts the adapter's ABSENT/NULL collapse as an equality, so it FAILS the day the adapter stops collapsing them -- a live tripwire, not a comment.

The committed fe-s-18-frozen.json map (9 v1 envelopes, the whole page's needs) plus a QUEUED status on the performance and holdings routes. source_dates carries NO business_date KEY AT ALL -- ABSENT, not null, which is the fact under test; a null would be a producer contract violation and a different fixture. resolve-scope is left UNTOUCHED because it is SCOPE, not state, and the page cannot reach its tabs without it.
